title: Get Segments Request
description: Request parameters for discovering or refining curated audience segments. buying_mode declares the buyer's intent: 'brief' for curated discovery using natural language, 'catalog' for structured browsing of the segment catalog, or 'refine' to iterate on known segments.

buying_mode.description: Declares buyer intent for this request. 'brief': curator recommends segments from the provided natural language description. 'catalog': buyer browses the raw segment catalog with structured filters — brief must not be provided. 'refine': iterate on segments from a previous get_segments response using the refine array of change requests.

brief.description: Natural language description of desired audience or inventory. Required when buying_mode is 'brief'. Must not be provided when buying_mode is 'catalog' or 'refine'.

refine.description: Array of change requests for iterating on segments from a previous get_segments response. Each entry declares a scope (request or segment) and what the buyer is asking for. Only valid when buying_mode is 'refine'.

scope.description: Change scoped to the overall request — direction for the selection as a whole.

ask.description: What the buyer is asking for at the request level (e.g., 'more video segments', 'higher scale options only').

scope.description: Change scoped to a specific segment.

id.description: Segment ID from a previous get_segments response.

action.description: 'include': return this segment with updated data. 'omit': exclude this segment from the response. 'more_like_this': find additional segments similar to this one (the original is also returned).

ask.description: What the buyer is asking for on this segment. For 'include': specific changes (e.g., 'also show mobile coverage'). For 'more_like_this': what 'similar' means (e.g., 'same audience but different geos'). Ignored when action is 'omit'.

filters.description: Structured filters to narrow segment results. Can be combined with brief for guided discovery.

countries.description: Filter to segments with coverage in these countries (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2)

devices.description: Filter to segments with coverage on these device types

ad_format_types.description: Filter to segments supporting these ad format types

platforms.description: Filter to segments available on these SSP platform IDs

categories.description: Filter to segments matching these category labels

max_floor_cpm.description: Maximum acceptable floor CPM — exclude segments with pricing guidance above this value

brand.description: Brand reference for segment discovery context. Curators may use brand information to filter segments by brand safety or category alignment.

account.description: Buyer's account with the curator. When provided, returns segments with account-specific pricing.

fields.description: Specific segment fields to include in the response. When omitted, all fields are returned. Required fields (segment_id, name) are always included.
